task_snapshots.title: Introduce repositories/DAL layer (new files only, no caller changes)
task_snapshots.description:
Every module in the codebase repeats the same `with get_db_connection() as conn: cur = conn.cursor(); cur.execute(...); rows = cur.fetchall()` boilerplate. Introduce a repository layer that centralizes SQL, returns plain dicts/dataclasses, and can be swapped/mocked in tests.

## Scope of THIS task
Only create NEW files under `app/repositories/`. Do NOT edit any existing files (endpoints.py, telegram_bot.py, notifications.py, monitoring.py, etc.) — a follow-up task will migrate callers. Keeping this task file-disjoint prevents merge conflicts with concurrent refactoring work.

## What to build
1. `app/repositories/__init__.py` — re-exports the public repository functions.
2. `app/repositories/endpoints.py` — `list_endpoints()`, `get_endpoint(id)`, `create_endpoint(name, url)`, `update_endpoint(id, name, url)`, `delete_endpoint(id)`, `update_status(id, status, checked_at)`, `mark_down(id, notified_at)`, `mark_up(id, notified_at)`, `update_notified(id, notified_at)`. Raise a small exception hierarchy: `EndpointNotFound`, `EndpointAlreadyExists` (wraps sqlite3.IntegrityError with a nicer message).
3. `app/repositories/subscriptions.py` — `list_subscriptions_for_endpoint(endpoint_id)`, `list_subscriptions_for_chat(chat_id)`, `get_subscription(id)`, `create_subscription(endpoint_id, chat_id, enabled=True)`, `toggle_subscription(id)`, `delete_subscription(id)`, `get_enabled_chat_ids_for_endpoint(endpoint_id)`.
4. `app/repositories/notification_logs.py` — `log_notification(endpoint_url, message, status, timestamp)`, `list_logs(page, per_page, sort_by, order, search, endpoint_filter, status_filter) -> (rows, total_count)`.
5. `app/repositories/settings.py` — `get_all()`, `update(key, value)`. (Do not touch existing `app/db.py:get_settings` — that shim will be replaced later.)
6. `app/repositories/discovery.py` — `find_pending(code)`, `mark_completed(id, chat_id, username, first_name, last_name)`, `create(code, expires_at, created_at)`.

## Conventions
- All functions accept required IDs as arguments and use `app.db.get_db_connection()` internally.
- All read functions return `list[dict]` or `dict | None`; boolean 0/1 columns are cast to Python bool.
- All write functions return the affected id (or None) and call `conn.commit()` inside their own `with` block.
- Use type hints everywhere.
- Do NOT add any tests here — Task 1 owns the test tree.

## Acceptance
All six repository files exist. `python -c "from app.repositories import endpoints, subscriptions, notification_logs, settings, discovery"` exits 0.
